title: SITC: Stage of Processing
description: This table provides a complete lookup for the classification of stage of processing, as applied and used by publications in Malaysia, primarily by DOSM.

fields.name: digits
fields.title: Digits
fields.description: [Integer] Number of digits; this column can be used as a filter if you only want to keep 1 digit codes, for example

fields.name: code
fields.title: Code
fields.description: [String] 1-4 digit codes; please ensure that you read this column as a string.

fields.name: desc_en
fields.title: Description (EN)
fields.description: [String] Description for the code, in English

fields.name: desc_bm
fields.title: Description (BM)
fields.description: [String] Description for the code, in Malay

methodology: The classification of stage of processing is consistent with the [Standard International Trade Classification (SITC) Revision 4](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/trade/sitcrev4.htm) published by the United Nations Statistics Division, which is used as a global reference in the classification of international merchandise trade.
